question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘uniformity’

A great variety of birds is found in the sanctuaries of India.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"uniformity"** means the quality or state of being uniform; overall sameness or homogeneity. (एकरूपता)

 
 
• **Example: **The** uniformity** of the soldiers' attire made it difficult to distinguish one from another.
 
 
 
• **"Variety" **refers to the quality or state of being different or diverse; the absence of uniformity or monotony. (विविधता)
 
 
• **Example: **The **variety** of flavors available at the ice cream shop was astonishing.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'uniformity' **is **'variety'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Great **(महान): Of an extent, amount, or intensity considerably above the normal or average.

 
 
• **Example:** He has achieved **great** success in his career.
 
 
 
• **Found **(मिला): To discover by chance or unexpectedly.
 
 
• **Example: **She **found **a rare coin in the attic.
 
 
 
• **Sanctuaries** (अभयारण्यों): A place of refuge or safety.
 
 
• **Example:** Many endangered species find** sanctuaries** in protected areas.
